name: EIGENVECTOR
body: A direction the matrix does not turn: A·v = λ·v. For a diagonal matrix, the axes.

name: ONLY ONE
body: A shear keeps exactly one direction: the one it slides along. Every other arrow tilts.

name: HIDDEN AXES
body: Some matrices hide their eigenvectors on diagonals: [[2, 1], [1, 2]] keeps (1, 1) and (1, −1).

name: MIRROR LINE
body: A mirror keeps the mirror line (λ = 1) and flips the line across it (λ = −1).

name: NO STRAIGHT PATH
body: A rotation turns every direction: no real eigenvector at all.
